name: sfguide-diagram
description:
Create an architecture or workflow diagram for a Snowflake developer guide (sfguide/quickstart)
as a reproducible matplotlib script and PNG. Reads the guide to find the Snowflake objects and
data flows, then renders boxes colored by object type, labeled arrows that never overlap boxes,
lines, or each other, and a legend underneath.

Use when: adding or replacing an architecture diagram in an sfguide, converting an
Excalidraw/hand-drawn diagram to code, diagramming the objects a quickstart creates.

Triggers: sfguide-diagram, sfguide diagram, architecture diagram for guide, quickstart diagram,
workflow diagram from guide, matplotlib architecture diagram.

Do NOT use for: charts of data values, slide decks, or diagrams unrelated to a guide's
Snowflake objects.
